scope: NXS/MESH triangle owner write/load and scalar adaptive index input.

validation.case_scope: Both endian modes round-trip nine separated triangles, tree, material IDs, original face IDs, group/category arrays and edge flags with exact stream cursor and complete owner cleanup. The open-surface fixture seeds a cached zero mass and a synthetic version 17; it does not establish compatibility with an independently captured native asset. Byte indices are exercised; wider indices are source-reviewed only. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
validation.private_constants: Mass uses existing private user-XEX bundle; no private data is published.
